$schemaComment: Disposable Maestro ownership/claim fixture roles (#574). Labels come from .env.maestro — never hardcode shared QA project chapters here.
description: Deterministic assignment roles for a dedicated disposable Fluent project. Run npm run maestro:fixtures:verify before ownership Maestro suites.

mine.notes: Assigned to MAESTRO_EMAIL (Draft or Not Started). Used for My Work + project-list mine icon.

other.notes: Assigned to another translator (or peerChecker ≠ MAESTRO_EMAIL at Peer Check). Taken-warning Record path.

unassigned.notes: No assignee / open ownership. List shows no ownership icon; Record has no taken warning.

claim.notes: Disposable unassigned chapter for online auto-claim. Reset after each claim run (Fluent web / admin).

conflict.notes: Chapter with hasConflict=true for list + Record conflict chrome. Optional until seed exists.

openPeerCheck.notes: Peer Check with no peerChecker. Optional until seed exists.
